dossier.title: Guardian Escort
briefing: I have a Python trader here who needs escort to the neighbour. She will not jump alone. She wants a gun beside her for the jump.
Take her into station range at the target. The work is honest and the pay is good. Prove yourself and there will be more work for you.

cover.arrive: Escort the Python to station range at {TARGET}. Your fee is {PAY}.
cover.success: The Python reached station range at {TARGET}.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants escort cover for a trader's jump.
